import scipy.optimize as so
def fitp(f,p0s):
    best=None
    for p0 in p0s:
        try:
            r=so.least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-dP_dt,p0,max_nfev=5000)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception as ex: pass
    return best, np.mean((f(best.x)-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
